    The ultralimit functional — foundation for the tracial matrix ultrapower R^ω #

    The single piece every route to germ_cstar_trace_descent (the C*/W*-structure + ultralimit trace on the matrix-ultrapower germ carrier) must build first: the ultralimit of a sequence along a nonprincipal ultrafilter ω, valued in a relatively-compact range.

    Both load-bearing descent functionals are instances of this single object:

    • the ultraproduct norm ‖[x]‖_ω := ultralim ω (fun n => ‖x n‖) (real-valued); and
    • the ultraproduct trace τ_ω([x]) := ultralim ω (fun n => τ_n (x n)) (ℂ-valued).

    This file proves the ultralimit kernel-trio (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound — the Classical.choice is intrinsic: lim of a filter is choice-defined, the framework's accepted ℝ-floor):

    • ultralim — the functional (topological lim of the pushed-forward ultrafilter).
    • tendsto_ultralim_of_isCompact — for a compact-range sequence, f genuinely ω-converges to ultralim ω f (the existence + convergence kernel, via IsCompact.ultrafilter_le_nhds).
    • ultralim_eq_of_tendsto — uniqueness: any ω-limit equals ultralim (Hausdorff).
    • ultralim_const, ultralim_add, ultralim_smul, ultralim_mono, ultralim_nonneg, ultralim_le_of_le, ultralim_norm_le — the linear/order/bound API the descent consumes.

    The remaining descent bricks (the bounded-sequence C*-algebra, the 2-norm-null ideal quotient, and the assembled CStarAlgebra instance on the ultraproduct) are tracked as precise sub-targets; see OPP-CEP-ULTRAPRODUCT-NORM-CSTAR and OPP-CEP-TWONORM-NULL-QUOTIENT.

    noncomputable def ZFib.CEP.Substrate.ultralim {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [Nonempty X] (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : ℕ → X) :
    X

    The ultralimit of a sequence along an ultrafilter.

    Defined as the topological limit of the pushed-forward ultrafilter ω.map f. This is a genuine limit (and f converges to it) exactly when the range of f is relatively compact — see tendsto_ultralim_of_isCompact. For an unbounded sequence the value is the junk lim of a non-convergent filter, so all substantive lemmas carry a compactness/boundedness hypothesis.

      For a sequence whose range lies in a compact set, f genuinely ω-converges to its ultralimit. This is the existence-and-convergence kernel of the whole construction.
